summary: Refactored CommandPalette into smaller Svelte 5 components and modules under apps/app/src/lib/features/sessions/command-palette/, removing the `active` prop and related $effect resets across RootCommandList, WorkspaceBrowser, and NativeWorkspacePicker. Rewrote the main CommandPalette.svelte to use the new structure, ran prettier, svelte-check, svelte-autofixer, and the full test suite — all passing with 0 errors and 308 tests green.
decisions: Split CommandPalette into separate files under apps/app/src/lib/features/sessions/command-palette/ (CommandPaletteContent, RootCommandList, WorkspaceBrowser, NativeWorkspacePicker, PaletteFooter, location.ts, types.ts) instead of keeping it monolithic.

Removed the `active` boolean prop from RootCommandList, WorkspaceBrowser, and NativeWorkspacePicker along with the $effect blocks that reset query/addError when `active` became true, relying instead on the parent's lifecycle.
Rewrote apps/app/src/lib/features/sessions/CommandPalette.svelte fully (78 LOC) to import and compose the new command-palette subcomponents with reload/close handlers.
Kept the async/debounced search effect in WorkspaceBrowser despite Svelte autofixer advisory suggestions about setTimeout/clearTimeout in $effect, since the behavior is intentional.
errors: Initial multi-edit on RootCommandList.svelte failed tool validation because the third edit was missing a required `newText` field; a corrected edit call succeeded.
